svg.metadata: Studio Tigz creative portfolio thumbnail. Custom HTML, CSS, UI, UX, branding, landing pages, responsive web design, front-end development, SaaS interfaces, e-commerce experiences, service brand websites, and digital concept work. This metadata preserves the artwork while making the thumbnail suitable for platforms that require a minimum upload size. Portfolio themes: boutique retail, survivor advocacy, automotive service, massage and bodywork, accounting and advisory. Visual direction: expressive, high-contrast, polished, modern, creative, responsive, and code-first. Studio Tigz is an independent web design and front-end development studio creating thoughtful digital experiences for modern brands. The thumbnail represents selected concepts and prototypes built with semantic HTML, responsive CSS, accessible interaction patterns, and carefully considered visual systems. Asset keywords: studio tigz, portfolio, web design, front end, developer, user interface, user experience, custom website, creative developer, responsive layout, CSS grid, flexbox, HTML5, visual identity, digital experience, concept vault, interactive prototype, mobile friendly, desktop friendly, modern website, Pueblo Colorado. Design notes: the left side presents the studio identity and technology tags, while the right side presents a structured collection of five representative website concepts. The composition is designed to remain legible as a wide website thumbnail and to communicate variety at a glance. Concept one explores a minimalist e-commerce experience for a luxury streetwear boutique. Concept two explores a motion-led advocacy experience with strong visual hierarchy and clear pathways. Concept three explores an automotive service brand with precision and confidence. Concept four explores a calm massage and bodywork studio with an editorial wellness direction. Concept five explores an accounting and advisory practice with clear information architecture, practical service language, and a refined dashboard-inspired visual system. Accessibility notes: text uses high contrast against the dark background, labels are short and scannable, decorative geometry supports rather than replaces the written identity, and the file remains a self-contained vector asset with no external dependencies. Production notes: this thumbnail is an original vector composition created for Studio Tigz. It is suitable for portfolio cards, project listings, social previews, website directories, presentation decks, and repository documentation. The SVG remains scalable from small mobile previews to large desktop displays. Search terms: portfolio thumbnail, website thumbnail, web developer portfolio image, digital studio preview, responsive web design showcase, custom HTML portfolio, CSS design portfolio, creative coding portfolio, UI design examples, UX design examples, landing page examples. Studio identity: Studio Tigz creates focused websites for SaaS teams, e-commerce brands, independent services, and people building something with intention. The work balances visual character, responsive behavior, semantic structure, and maintainable code. Thumbnail purpose: provide a clear first impression of the Studio Tigz portfolio, show a range of design directions, establish a recognizable color system, and make the collection easy to identify wherever the portfolio is shared. Visual system: deep navy background, electric blue, vivid violet, bright pink, cool white typography, subtle translucent panels, soft glow, structured grid, rounded modules, and concise labels. The colors are intentionally varied so the image remains energetic without becoming visually noisy. Format notes: SVG vector artwork, 1280 by 720 viewBox, transparent-free dark background, embedded gradients, embedded typography labels, no network requests, no raster image dependency, no external font dependency, and safe to preview in modern browsers. Studio Tigz portfolio collection: boutique landing, reclaim advocacy, ledger loom, low tide, torquehaus, custom web design, front-end development, visual design systems, interaction design, responsive layout, accessible navigation, project storytelling, and digital strategy. This additional descriptive metadata is intentionally invisible in the rendered thumbnail. It does not cover, shift, recolor, resize, or otherwise alter any visible artwork. It simply keeps the delivered asset above a minimum file-size requirement while retaining the original visual quality and scalable vector format.
